top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver had seven students in care ages 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, and 22 months old. The operation was out of ratio by one student.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations active play space was observed to have a hoe, weeder, and multiple shovels present. The operations backyard fence has multiples gaps measuring larger than 3.5 inches and less than 9 inches.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §747.1207(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Pre-Employment affidavit was not made available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no admission information available for children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - Affidavit (26 TAC §747.1207(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers do not have to review  a notarized Licensing Affidavit for Applicants for Employment form.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 out of 12 children did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Emergency Plan (26 TAC §747.605(16))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Out of the three records for children evaluated during the inspection one child with a diagnosed food allergy, did not have a completed Food Allergy Emergency Plan completed and signed by the child's parent and their health care professional.
